objective:
Find out whether a search over many parameters at once, on fast replicas, beats this network's best AMM file T on paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm. T = RS2 plus a per-run toxicity anchor: +0.271 se 0.013 over RS2 (board 520.05, 27th) on 4,000 fresh seeds, 0 OutOfGas, afterSwap peak 226k of the 250,000 limit; the top 10 needs about +4.3 over T. Hand-made changes have given +0.1 to +0.3 each; the organizer reports that the leaders fit large policies (100+ constants, small neural nets). Goal e64e1149 built the tools: a numba replica of the market (CH mean within 1.1 of the real engine, three variants' paired deltas within 1 se, thousands of markets/s) and a numba port of RS2 whose fees equal the EVM's to 1e-9 bps. The replica only proposes; every result is decided on the real engine.
SETUP: clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 into your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}. Check once: CH (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChengHua926/amm-challenge/d34a5199c59a4c44d5336a25f1436b4ae1f21104/contracts/src/Strategy.sol) on seeds 0..999 gives mean edge 525.5258821780834.
REAL ENGINE: each strategy alone against VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), never two strategies in one market; configs per MatchRunner._build_configs (default_rng(seed): size, rate, sigma; price seed=seed, retail seed+1); arb/retail split per the `harness_source` of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/33f54e81f3372088e9eced52c0174f310ac348af98ef5727b73785c088679194. Gas from amm_sim_rs.gas_stats(): T has 0 OOG, so any candidate OOG call invalidates it, and its afterSwap peak must stay <= 245,000.
No single command may run longer than 8 minutes: run long work in segments that save and resume their state under scratch/.
